name: Salinillas de Bureba (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of purple, white and purple with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Salinillas de Bureba (roses on white above a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Salinillas de Bureba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Salinillas de Bureba arms — roses above a castle
